Permits & License Committee  November 26, 2025
Minutes  Page 1 of 3

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  November 26, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room # A, 1St
Floor. On November 26, 2025, at 2:01 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:
  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department
  Jerry Tucker, Code Enforcement Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on November 13, 2025

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Sharis Rhodes on behalf of Rhodes Enterprises LLC to host the 2nd Annual Inglewood
  Christmas Parade Event from Prairie to Manchester and Manchester to Kareem Court
  Public Property; on Wednesday, December 3, 2025, from 5:00 p.m. to 6:15 p.m.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1) day parade event on Prairie Ave. and
  Kareem Ct. Subject to Public Works approval for use /closure of the right-of-way. Applicant
  is responsible for crowd control and event cleanup; Police and TCO staffing will be
  deployed at this event for public safety and traffic control ( 1 Lt., 2 Sergeants, 16 Police
  officers, and 20 TCOs). This event is now expected to travel to the Forum Parking Lot via
  Prairie Avenue. None Code Enforcement conditions; None conditions for Fire Approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00407258)
 Permits & License Committee  November 26, 2025
Minutes  Page 2 of 3

Item #2:  Aaliyah Wilson on behalf of Venice Family Clinic to host a Venice Family Clinic Children’s
  Holiday Movie Event at 226 S Market St., Private Property; on Saturday, December 13,
  2025, from 11:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1)
  day event within The Miracle Theater. Applicant responsible for crows control, event clean
  up, and applicable mitigation measures; Applicant to hire a minimum of (5) professional-
  licensed security staff for the safety of attendees. Applicant to hire (2) TCO’s; NO alcoholic
  beverages are to be served during this children’s holiday movie event. The IPD Watch
  Commander will be notified, and an extra patrol will be provided as time permits; Applicant
  to submit event surveys from impacted businesses; Adhere to local state and federal laws;
  None Code Enforcement conditions; None conditions for Fire Approval; Maintain site at all
  times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and
  staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County,
  and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00407198)

Item #3:  Rev Capt. Anthony Penn, on behalf of Morningside United Church of Christ / Reverend
  Captain Anthony Penn, to host a Parking Lot Garage Sale Event at 8800 S Crenshaw
  Blvd, Private Property; on Saturday, December 6, 2025, from 9:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for 1-day event within a private parking lot.
  Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean-up, and all applicable mitigation
  measures. Applicant to hire two (1) professional licensed security guards for the safety of
  attendees. The applicant may use off-duty law enforcement officers who are a part of the
  congregation. Security Staff must wear a reflective vest for visibility/risk management
  reasons. Applicant must ensure the parking lot where garage sale is located is free from
  vehicular traffic for the safety of pedestrains; No Code Enforcement Conditions; None
  conditions for Fire Approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department;
  and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00407047)

New Tobacco Retailer License Renewal Request (s):

Item #5:  Jawdat Mashhour, DBA Circus Liquor La Brea, to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 1435 N
  LA BREA AVE. This Business License has been APPROVED with the following
  condition set forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee: Must adhere to all City of
  Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically, CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS
  FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to
  all State and Federal Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 32 Square Feet or 25%
  of total retail floor areaSales or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of
  Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored
  Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored
  Smokeless Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own
  Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly
  Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21
  is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have
  a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display of any type of
  weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are
  subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or
  night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products within
  existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah products) to
  minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products
  SHALL have a valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction of underage
  tobacco use, including hookah products; Submit all state tobacco renewal certificates if
  applicable;NO loitering of persons outside of the location; NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING
  SIGNS MUST Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00407114)

Public Comments

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any matters connected with items on the Agenda, it was reported that there were no public
requests to speak.
